display_information.name: Link Bookmarks
display_information.description: Save, organize, edit, and share links without leaving Slack.
display_information.long_description:
Link Bookmarks gives each person in your workspace a personal collection of saved links. Save a URL with a slash command, manage your collection from the app's Home tab, and share your list into a channel when you want to.

Features:
• Save one or more links at once with /save-link (comma or line separated)
• Manage your collection from the App Home tab: edit link titles and URLs, or delete links you no longer need
• Search your saved links by keyword with /show-links
• Remove links through a checklist with /delete-links
• Add several links at once from the "Add Links" global shortcut
• Open your saved list anytime from the "Show Saved Links" global shortcut
• Set a sort order and notification preference in the Home tab settings
• Post your saved links to a channel by messaging "share links"

Use cases:
• Keep reference links, docs, and articles in one place while you work in Slack
• Collect resources during a project and share the set with a channel when it's ready
• Give each teammate their own private, searchable bookmark list

Setup: Works immediately after install. Open the App Home tab to view your bookmarks and save your first link with /save-link.
